name: Salsa Chicken
desc: Chicken breasts rubbed with taco seasoning, baked under salsa, and finished with melted cheddar.

source.title: Salsa Chicken
source.evidence: All five ingredients and amounts match this page (4 breasts, 4 tsp taco seasoning, 1 cup salsa, 1 cup shredded cheddar, optional sour cream), as do the 375°F bake and the cheese added for the last few minutes.

ingredients.raw: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts (about 2 lb total)
1 cup jarred tomato salsa, mild or medium
Nonstick cooking spray or oil, for the dish

steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Lightly grease a 9x13 in baking dish and lay the chicken in it in one layer.
Sprinkle the taco seasoning on both sides of the chicken, then pour the salsa over everything.
Bake until the thickest part of the chicken reads 165°F, 25-35 min.
Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the chicken and bake until melted and bubbly, 3-5 min more. Serve topped with the sour cream if you like.
tips: Thick breasts cook unevenly; pound them to an even 3/4 inch or halve them horizontally for the shorter end of the bake time.
